# What is Rapid Building?

#### Course: Rapid Build With Claude Code

## What is Rapid Building?

Rapid building is not about speed. I know that sounds counterintuitive, but stay with me.

It is about removing the friction between "I have an idea" and "it is live and shareable." The trap most developers fall into is either over-engineering before writing a line of code, or under-planning and rewriting everything three times. Rapid building is the middle path.

The way I define it:

- Decisions before code
- Architecture before execution
- Sequencing before speed

When you do those three things in order, the actual building goes fast - because you are never blocked by a decision you haven't made yet.
